fonts.name: Manrope
fonts.usage: H1, H2, H3, Layer Titles, Primary Navigation

fonts.name: IBM Plex Sans
fonts.usage: Body text, PubMed data, Evidence Badges, Data tables

rules.headings: Tight letter spacing (tracking-tight), use font-light or font-bold (skip normal weight for contrast).
rules.labels: Uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs for layer labels and evidence categories.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Medical/Clinical: Solid backgrounds for panels. Avoid glassmorphism to prevent visual refraction of data. Use subtle 1px border (#E5E5E0) and soft shadow-sm.
visual_enhancers.borders: Rounded-xl for main panels, rounded-md for internal cards and badges.
visual_enhancers.textures: Clean matte finish. No heavy gradients. Flat design for data clarity.

grids.base: Bento Grid Hybrid for Dashboard. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4 or gap-6.

layouts.dashboard: 100vh layout with sticky top header. Main content area takes remaining height with overflow-hidden to keep 3D canvas fixed, while side panels scroll.
layouts.dental_chart: FDI 11-48 pure CSS/SVG grid overlay, mapping teeth to meridians/organs.

motion.layers: Fade in/out for layer toggles (framer-motion opacity transitions).
motion.3d: Smooth orbiting and zoom on click. Auto-rotate slowly when idle (optional).

accessibility.contrast: APCA & WCAG AA compliant. Dark text on light backgrounds. Use bold white text on evidence level badges.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All layer toggles, search inputs, and list items MUST have data-testid (e.g., data-testid='layer-toggle-skelett', data-testid='search-pubmed-input').

image_urls.description: Anatomy of man. Can be used as a 2D fallback image if 3D fails to load.
Human anatomy figure below white wooden ceiling. Good for login/admin page background.

media.icons: lucide-react for UI actions. @react-icons for medical/dental specific icons (if needed).

3d_libraries.strategy: Create a robust `<Canvas>` spanning the center column. Use `<OrbitControls>`. If no GLTF/GLB body model is provided, use procedural generation: a translucent `<Capsule>` or `<Sphere>` as body, with distinct `<Sphere>` nodes placed at varying coordinates to represent nerves/pressure points. Use different colors for layers (e.g., Blue=Nerves, Orange=TCM). Add click handlers to these nodes to update the right-side detail panel.

component_path.ui_components: Shadcn UI (Button, Card, Badge, Input, Label, Tabs, ScrollArea, Switch, Dialog for Admin Login/CRUD).
component_path.custom_components: Create 'DentalChart2D.js' for FDI tooth mapping. Create 'LayerControls.js' for 3D toggles. Create 'PubMedPanel.js' for search.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: lucide-react, framer-motion, react-three-fiber, @react-three/drei, three.
Ensure UI is in GERMAN as requested.
Implement the UI layout with Tailwind CSS. Avoid dark backgrounds, stick to the light Medical/Earthy theme.
The 3D Canvas must support multiple layers. Store layer visibility in a React state (e.g., { skin: true, skeleton: false, nerves: true }) and pass it to the 3D scene to render/hide groups of nodes.

For the Dental Chart (Zahn-Nerven/Gebiss), create a 2D grid representing teeth (FDI 11-48). Allow clicking a tooth (e.g., 13 oberer rechter Eckzahn) to show its meridian/organ correlation (e.g., Becken/Pelvis chain).
Evidence Badges must clearly indicate 'Gut belegt', 'Mäßig', 'Schwach', 'TCM', 'Andere'. Use distinct colors from the guideline.
The PubMed integration can be mocked if an API key isn't provided, but structure it to fetch from `https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi` or similar if possible.
Admin Login (Local Host Drop-in): Create a simple mock authentication. Add a button to 'Drop-in Order für Zusatz Studien' (could just be a file upload button mock for now).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
